Name: (AT) Fence Lamps
Author: xliczkax
Description:
I was in a desperate need for some lighting for my farm that could match the default vanilla style. 
I love to place lamps on the corners of fences but they all looked very off on their own.
Because of that I quickly made this for my own use but figured out some of you might like it as well~

Adds new look to the [b]Wood Lamp[/b] and [b]Iron Lamp[/b] that matches the default Hardwood Fences.
Comes with two styles with all the connective swatches and they all work on both Lamps!

This is my first mod like that so if you encounter any problems please let me know.

[b][size=3]! [/size][/b][size=1]You need the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][size=1] mod for this to work.[/size]
[b][size=3]![/size][/b][size=1] Also I highly recommend using it with the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17485?tab=videos]Connect Your Fences[/url][size=1] mod so everything can connect nicely! The fences will not connect to the lamps on their own, so this or a similar mod is needed![/size]
